A Taste of Italy in Dalat
Jul 2025 • Couples
My husband and I had dinner at Emai during our trip to Dalat in the monsoon season last year. It is located a bit away from the main market area. We were craving good Italian food and came across Emai through a Google search, so we decided to go there for dinner. The restaurant has a tricky entrance. They have multiple levels of seating. When we arrived, the restaurant was fully booked, with only one table available outside. It had a beautiful view and luckily, it was not raining. We took our chance. The service was quick and amazing. Everything we ordered was beautifully presented and absolutely delicious. The tiramisu was one of the best I had in Vietnam. It was so light and not too sweet. The restaurant went out of its way to enhance the overall dining experience by offering a complimentary appetizer at the start and a piece of chocolate in the end. I highly recommend Emai to anyone looking for a fine-dining experience or a special occasion dinner in Dalat.

Greedy charges!
Feb 2026 • Family
I have eaten here a few times before and found it quite good. Today, while my own food was decent, I was disappointed with the bill.
The issue is one of principle. My daughter is six years old and only eats a small child’s portion of plain spaghetti with a little olive oil. In most restaurants, this costs around 50,000–70,000 VND, or is sometimes not charged at all due to the size and simplicity.
On this visit, we were charged 240,000 VND for her dish. After raising the issue, the price was reduced by 30%, but 170,000 VND for a very small, basic child’s portion still feels unreasonable.
The staff explained the price by mentioning complimentary bread and a small chocolate at the end of the meal. While these are nice touches, they do not justify such a high charge for a simple children’s dish.
Overall, the food is good and the restaurant itself is pleasant, which is why we have returned. However, the way this situation was handled has left a negative impression. Families with children may want to clarify prices in advance to avoid surprises.

Beautiful hidden home stay in Dalat
Sep 2024 • Couples
We stayed one night in Emai Homestay and one night in Emai Valley
Emai Valley is the newer property and has the restaurant attached
Both have beautiful gardens and breakfast in each spot was really excellent. We were able to eat it in the lovely gardens 
Emai Valley was the more comfortable room but this is reflected in the more expensive room rate. It had a much more comfortable bed and better equipped ensuite bathroom with shower and a wooden bath tub.
We had dinner in Emai restaurant which was superb
The ambiance, wine, food and service was an absolute delight. I would highly recommend Emai Valley to anyone looking for a unique and special experience with a very cosy and friendly ambiance
